const OLD={"wraith-w75-v2-magnetic-ansi-us-phantom-white":["139,90 €",21],"akko-5075-v3-he-ansi-us-8k-white":["99,90 €",20],"akko-ray68-he-wireless-ansi-us-white":["99,90 €",20],"atk-rs6-ultra-he-ansi-us-white-shadow-warrior-ttc-rgb-magneto":["159,90 €",13]};
PRICE["pulsar-zywoo-the-chosen-gen-3-medium-8k-wireless-yellow"]="159,90 €";PRICE["atk-x1-v2-ultimate-plus-8k-wireless-white"]="89,90 €";PRICE["vxe-r1-wireless-white"]="44,90 €";
OOS.add("pulsar-zywoo-the-chosen-gen-3-medium-8k-wireless-yellow");OOS.add("atk-x1-v2-ultimate-plus-8k-wireless-white");
Object.assign(PRICE,{"vxe-r1-pro-wireless-white":"50 €","vxe-mad-r-8k-wireless-black":"60 €","atk-dragonfly-a9-plus-2-0-wireless-black":"45 €","mchose-a7-v2-ultra-plus-8k-wireless-white":"65 €","atk-blazing-sky-zero-8k-wireless-white":"90 €","scyrox-v8s-8k-wireless-white":"75 €","scyrox-v6s-8k-wireless-white":"75 €","lamzu-maya-x-8k-wireless-purple-shadow":"125 €","wlmouse-ying-magnesium-8k-wireless-white":"140 €","wlmouse-beast-x-max-8k-magnesium-wireless-metallic-silver":"160 €","pulsar-x2-crazylight-medium-8k-wireless-uyuni-white":"150 €","pulsar-x2-crazylight-mini-8k-wireless-bruce-lee-85th-ed":"160 €","razer-viper-v4-pro-8k-wireless-white":"180 €","razer-deathadder-v4-pro-wireless-niko-edition":"200 €","mchose-l7-pro-8k-wireless-white":"65 €","mchose-a5-v3-ultra-8k-wireless-white":"60 €","atk-blazing-sky-x1-air-8k-wireless-shadow-white":"90 €","atk-x1-v2-ultimate-plus-8k-wireless-white":"89,90 €","atk-blazing-sky-f1-v3-ultimate-plus-8k-wireless-white":"90 €","lamzu-inca-8k-wireless-white":"110 €","atk-dragonfly-a9-mini-plus-8k-wireless-white":"90 €","atk-dragonfly-a9-air-8k-wireless-shadow-white":"90 €","atk-dragonfly-a9-air-plus-8k-wireless-shadow-white":"90 €","mchose-k7-ultra-s-8k-wireless-white-gold":"80 €","endgame-gear-op1-8k-v2-white":"70 €","endgame-gear-op1w-4k-wireless-white":"69,90 €","endgame-gear-xm2w-4k-wireless-black":"75 €","endgame-gear-xm2-8k-black":"50 €","atk-ghost-ultimate-8k-wireless-black":"115 €"});
["vxe-r1-pro-wireless-white","vxe-mad-r-8k-wireless-black","razer-deathadder-v4-pro-wireless-niko-edition","mchose-a5-v3-ultra-8k-wireless-white","atk-blazing-sky-x1-air-8k-wireless-shadow-white","endgame-gear-op1-8k-v2-white"].forEach(s=>OOS.add(s));
Object.assign(OLD,{"mchose-a7-v2-ultra-plus-8k-wireless-white":["80 €",19],"wlmouse-ying-magnesium-8k-wireless-white":["150 €",7],"mchose-k7-ultra-s-8k-wireless-white-gold":["90 €",11],"endgame-gear-op1w-4k-wireless-white":["119,90 €",42],"endgame-gear-xm2w-4k-wireless-black":["120 €",38],"endgame-gear-xm2-8k-black":["75 €",33]});
const num=sl=>{const p=PRICE[sl];return p?parseFloat(p.replace(",",".")):null};
const tM=m=>{const n=num(m[4]);return n==null?m[1]:n<60?1:n<=100?2:3};
const tK=k=>{const n=num(k[4]);return n==null?k[1]:n<80?1:n<=130?2:3};
const SETUP=[{"s": "setup-zero", "n": "ATK Zero Extreme+ 8K Wireless – Frosted Orange", "p": "149,90 €", "t": ["🖱️ Souris", "8K · 44 g", "Symétrique"], "u": "https://maxesport.gg/search?q=ATK%20Zero%20Extreme%2B%208K%20Wireless%20Frosted%20Orange&bg_ref=JS7N", "i": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"s": "setup-mod68", "n": "Akko MOD68 HE – Misty White [AstroAim]", "p": "94,90 €", "t": ["⌨️ Clavier", "68%", "QWERTY"], "u": "https://maxesport.gg/search?q=Akko%20MOD68%20HE%20ANSI%20US%20Misty%20White&bg_ref=JS7N", "i": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"s": "setup-pd170", "n": "Pulsar eS PD170 XL – eS Blue", "p": "59,90 €", "t": ["🟦 Tapis", "XL 480×400 mm", "Soft"], "u": "https://maxesport.gg/search?q=Pulsar%20eS%20PD170%20XL%20eS%20Blue&bg_ref=JS7N", "i": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"s": "setup-tenta", "n": "Tenta-X The Last Stand V2 – Issen", "p": "94,90 €", "t": ["🟦 Tapis", "Glasspad XL 490×420", "Rigide"], "u": "https://maxesport.gg/search?q=Tenta-X%20The%20Last%20Stand%20V2%20Issen&bg_ref=JS7N", "i": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"s": "setup-saturn", "n": "Pulsar eS Saturn Pro Soft XL – Radiant Ruby", "p": "59,90 €", "t": ["🟦 Tapis", "XL 490×420 mm", "Soft"], "u": "https://maxesport.gg/search?q=Pulsar%20eS%20Saturn%20Pro%20Soft%20XL%20Radiant%20Ruby&bg_ref=JS7N", "i": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}];
OOS.add("setup-mod68");OOS.add("setup-pd170");
OLD["setup-mod68"]=["104,90 €",10];
const NOTE={"endgame-gear-xm2w-4k-wireless-black":"Main plus large que pour les OP1","endgame-gear-xm2-8k-black":"Main plus large que pour les OP1","atk-blazing-sky-f1-v3-ultimate-plus-8k-wireless-white":"Palm : main S · Claw/Palm : main M"};
const S={tab:"mice",tier:"all",budget:200,grip:"all",hand:"all",size:"all",layout:"all",type:"all"};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const TABS={mice:"🖱️ Souris",kb:"⌨️ Claviers",pad:"🟦 Tapis",setup:"🔥 Mon setup"};
const chips=(key,opts)=>opts.map(([v,l])=>`<button class="chip ${S[key]===v?"on":""}" data-k="${key}" data-v="${v}">${l}</button>`).join("");
const slider=max=>`<div class="row"><label>Budget max</label><input type="range" id="bud" min="15" max="${max}" step="5" value="${S.budget}"><b>${S.budget} €</b></div>`;
function render(skip){
 $("nav").innerHTML=Object.entries(TABS).map(([k,l])=>`<button class="${S.tab===k?"on":""}" data-tab="${k}">${l}</button>`).join("");
 let f="",list=[];
 if(S.tab==="mice"){
  f=`<div class="row"><label>Budget</label>${chips("tier",[["all","Tous"],["1","💰 &lt; 60 €"],["2","💰💰 60–100 €"],["3","💰💰💰 &gt; 100 €"]])}</div><div class="row"><label>Grip</label>${chips("grip",[["all","Tous"],["claw","Claw"],["palm","Palm"],["fingertip","Fingertip"]])}</div>
  <div class="row"><label>Taille de main</label>${chips("hand",[["all","Toutes"],["S","S (&lt;17 cm)"],["M","M (17–19)"],["L","L (&gt;19)"]])}</div>`;
  const GN={c:"claw",p:"palm",f:"fingertip"},TL={1:"💰 &lt; 60 €",2:"💰💰 60–100 €",3:"💰💰💰 &gt; 100 €"};
  list=MICE.filter(m=>(S.tier==="all"||String(tM(m))===S.tier)&&(S.grip==="all"||m[2].includes(S.grip[0]))&&(S.hand==="all"||m[3].includes(S.hand)))
   .map(m=>[m[0],PRICE[m[4]]||TL[m[1]],[...m[2].split("").map(g=>GN[g]),"main "+m[3].split("").join("/")],NOTE[m[4]]||"",
   "https://maxesport.gg/products/"+m[4]+"?bg_ref=JS7N",IMG[m[4]]||"",m[4]]);
 }else if(S.tab==="kb"){
  f=`<div class="row"><label>Budget</label>${chips("tier",[["all","Tous"],["1","💰 &lt; 80 €"],["2","💰💰 80–130 €"],["3","💰💰💰 &gt; 130 €"]])}</div>
  <div class="row"><label>Taille</label>${chips("size",[["all","Toutes"],["60%","60%"],["68%","68%"],["75%","75%"],["TKL","TKL / 80%"]])}</div>
  <div class="row"><label>Layout</label>${chips("layout",[["all","Tous"],["A","AZERTY (ISO FR)"],["Q","QWERTY (ANSI US)"]])}</div>`;
  const TK={1:"💰 &lt; 80 €",2:"💰💰 80–130 €",3:"💰💰💰 &gt; 130 €"};
  list=KB.filter(k=>(S.tier==="all"||String(tK(k))===S.tier)&&(S.size==="all"||k[2]===S.size)&&(S.layout==="all"||k[3]===S.layout))
   .map(k=>[k[0],PRICE[k[4]]||TK[k[1]],[k[2],k[3]==="A"?"AZERTY":"QWERTY"],"","https://maxesport.gg/products/"+k[4]+"?bg_ref=JS7N",IMG[k[4]]||"",k[4]]);
 }else if(S.tab==="setup"){
  f=`<div class="row"><label>Mon setup</label><span>Le matos que j’utilise au quotidien 🔥</span></div>`;
  list=SETUP.map(x=>[x.n,x.p,x.t,"",x.u,x.i,x.s]);
 }else{
  f=slider(80)+`<div class="row"><label>Type</label>${chips("type",[["all","Tous"],["speed","Speed"],["hybride","Hybride"],["control","Control"]])}</div>`;
  list=PAD.filter(p=>p[1]<=S.budget&&(S.type==="all"||p[2]===S.type)).map(p=>[p[0],p[1],[p[2]],p[3]]);
 }
 list.sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);
 if(!skip)$("filters").innerHTML=f;
 $("count").textContent=list.length+" résultat"+(list.length>1?"s":"");
 $("grid").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(i=>`<div class="card${OOS.has(i[6])?" oos":""}">${OOS.has(i[6])?'<span class="rup">Rupture</span>':""}${i[5]?`<img class="pic" src="${i[5]}" alt="${i[0]}" loading="lazy">`:""}<h3>${i[0]}</h3><div class="p">${i[1]}${OLD[i[6]]?` <s class="old">${OLD[i[6]][0]}</s> <span class="disc">−${OLD[i[6]][1]}%</span>`:""}</div><div class="tags">${i[2].map(t=>`<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join("")}</div><small>${i[3]}</small>${i[4]?`<a class="ph" href="${i[4]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener sponsored">${OOS.has(i[6])?"🔔 Me prévenir du retour (MaxEsport)":"🛒 Voir sur MaxEsport (code JS7N −5%)"}</a>`:""}</div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">${S.tab==="mice"?"Aucun résultat : assouplis un filtre.":"Mes recommandations arrivent bientôt 🔥"}</div>`;
 const b=$("bud");if(b)b.oninput=e=>{S.budget=+e.target.value;b.nextElementSibling.textContent=S.budget+" €";render(true)};
}
function update(){const y=window.scrollY;render();window.scrollTo(0,y)}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
 const cb=e.target.closest("[data-c]");if(cb){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(cb.dataset.c)}catch(x){}cb.textContent="Copié !";setTimeout(()=>cb.textContent="Copier",1500);return}
 const t=e.target.closest("[data-tab]");
 if(t){S.tab=t.dataset.tab;S.tier="all";S.size="all";S.layout="all";S.type="all";render();return}
 const c=e.target.closest(".chip");if(c){S[c.dataset.k]=c.dataset.v;render()}
});
S.budget=100;render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
